To: Rewards Administration Desk, Coburn Office Supply
From: Rosemary Attwell
Date: April 14
Subject: Rewards balances at our two offices
Accounts concerned: RW-6314 (Eastgate office), RW-6320 (Ambleside office)
Copy: Branch Accounts Team
To the Rewards Administration Desk:
Our practice keeps a rewards account for each of its two offices. The Eastgate account shows 5,600 credits, of which 3,000 were awarded under the spring bonus offer rather than earned on purchases. The Ambleside account shows 2,600 credits, all earned on supply orders. Two years ago we claimed a coffee machine for the Eastgate break room.
Neither balance is large enough on its own, so I am asking that the two totals be brought together under the Eastgate account. Our records room could use the storage cabinet in the current catalog, though I expect that is beyond our reach. Otherwise we would like the single item of greatest value that our combined credit will cover.
Thank you for your assistance,
Rosemary Attwell
Office Manager, Lassiter Dental Group
Eastgate office
P.S. The Eastgate credit expires on May 31, so an early decision would help us.
----------------------
Combining Rewards Balances: Program Rules
For member businesses holding accounts at more than one branch.
A. Who may ask, and how
Both accounts must be registered to the same member business, and the request must be put in writing by the person named as the contact on each account. Requests from other staff are returned without action.
B. Credit that carries across
Credit earned on supply orders carries across in full. Credit awarded through a bonus offer carries across at half its value, and the reduction is applied before the two totals are added.
C. What a combined balance cannot buy
A combined balance may not be used for any category supplied by an outside company rather than from the program's own stock. Those items must be claimed against a single account.
D. Timing
Requests are settled within ten business days. Credit that expires during that period cannot be restored.
Questions may be sent to the Rewards Administration Desk.

Product Development Notes
Home Panel Findings Lead to Two Design Changes
Two features of the cordless sweeper made by Hollingsworth Home Products were altered after the company's first home trial cycle closed in March.
The dust container on the sample unit was enlarged, and the power switch was moved from the body of the machine to the handle. Comments about the noise of the motor were also common, but the motor itself was left unchanged.
Ninety households took part, each using a preproduction unit for six weeks in place of its own cleaning equipment and filing three short written reports.
"A machine behaves differently in a home than it does in our testing rooms," said Nigel Braithwaite, who manages the panel program at the research office. "Neither change would have been made without the panel."
The cycle now under way differs in one respect. Members are being placed in two groups, and one group will keep its sample unit for twelve weeks instead of six.
Gwen Aldridge, contributing writer, Household Trade Review
[Figures supplied by the manufacturer's research office.]
----------------------
Subject: Home panel, cycle beginning in May
To: Lucia Moreno
From: Nigel Braithwaite
Date: May 2
Panel reference: HP-6402
Enclosed: Home Panel Reporting Schedule
Hello Ms. Moreno,
Your place on the current panel is confirmed, and everything you need for the coming weeks is set out below.
Your trial will run for twelve weeks rather than the usual six, so the unit is due back with us in early August.
The kit will reach you on May 5. It contains one sweeper, a spare filter, and a care sheet. The sweeper is the revised sample built after the first cycle, not the standard unit now sold in stores.
The enclosed schedule gives the reporting dates. Please read the rows marked for a longer trial as well as the rows that apply to everyone.
Please write back to confirm that a weekday delivery can be accepted at your address, as the courier will not hold the kit for a second day.
Nigel Braithwaite
Panel Coordinator
Research Office, Hollingsworth Home Products
Telephone extension 218
P.S. Please keep the shipping carton. You will need it to send the unit back at the end of the trial.
----------------------
Home Panel Reporting Schedule
Scope: applies to every member enrolled in the cycle beginning in May. Rows marked extended use apply only to members whose trial period runs for twelve weeks.
Round	Reporting window	Report covers	Attach with report
Round 1	May 12-18	First two weeks of use	No attachment
Round 2	June 2-8	Results on two types of floor	Two photographs of the unit in use
Round 3	June 16-22	Overall opinion of the unit	Completed condition checklist
Round 4 (extended use)	July 28 - August 3	Performance after long use	Battery charging log
1. Reports are entered on the member page of the company website. Paper reports are not accepted.
2. A member who misses a reporting window should telephone the research office, which will set a single replacement date.
